entities.name: Duke Adolf Friedrich of Mecklenburg-Schwerin
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Duke Adolf Friedrich Albrecht Heinrich of Mecklenburg-Schwerin, was a German explorer in Africa, a colonial politician, and the first president of the National Olympic Committee of West Germany (1949–1951).
